note: Pronouncing and bilingual lexicon of the Mandarin fiber: every CC-CEDICT reading of every single Han character and of every word of mandarin-lexicon.json, one reading per line as simplified headword, numbered pinyin and a gloss, tab-separated. The gloss is the reading's first sense that is not only a variant, surname or cross-reference entry, with parentheticals removed and its first ;-alternative kept, at most 40 characters. A reading that is only a variant, surname or cross-reference entry is dropped when the headword has another reading.
